# PopoverService

Opens nonmodal text or template content next to an explicit DOM anchor.

## Identity

- Class: `PopoverService`
- Kind: root-provided Angular service
- Import from: `@arcwell/ui`
- [Service source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/overlays/popover.service.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Inject the service with Angular `inject(PopoverService)` or constructor injection.
- Read the method signatures and related types below before building configuration objects or handling returned references.
- Subscribe to lifecycle observables exposed by returned references when the application needs completion, action, or dismissal results. Clean up caller-owned subscriptions normally.
- Use the linked Storybook examples as executable recipes; their Actions entries show real service callbacks.
- Do not invent component inputs for a service or assume that component output observers capture programmatic service events.

## Related configuration, reference and provider APIs

```ts
export interface PopoverConfig {
  placement?: AnchorPlacement;
  offset?: number;
  width?: string;
  maxWidth?: string;
  viewportMargin?: number;
  panelClass?: string | string[];
  ariaLabel?: string;
  id?: string;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  restoreFocus?: boolean;
  closeOnEscape?: boolean;
  closeOnOutside?: boolean;
  /** Preserves the caller's injection context for template content. */
  viewContainerRef?: ViewContainerRef;
  /** CSS custom properties supported by the floating panel. */
  styles?: Record<string, string>;
}

export type PopoverCloseReason = "api" | "escape" | "outside" | "destroy";

export class PopoverRef {
  readonly afterClosed: import("rxjs").Observable<PopoverCloseReason>;
  updatePosition(): void;
  close(reason: PopoverCloseReason = "api"): void;
}
```
